name: San Giorgio Bigarello (Italy)
description: Green field with yellow oak sprigs in the corners, charged with a large yellow lozenge bearing Saint George on horseback slaying the dragon.
history: Municipal flag of San Giorgio Bigarello, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: lozenge throughout with oak sprigs in the four corners
Saint George on a white horse slaying the dragon
armour and lance of the saint
